summary: Focused testing of 4 new AtelierAI features: (1) Emergent Object Storage + private files, (2) HF IDM-VTON adapter with mock fallback, (3) Product import connectors (JSON + URL), (4) Anonymised research export (JSON/CSV). Backend 16/16 pytest passed. Frontend UI flows verified via Playwright (Admin Import, Admin Export, TryOn with adapter selection, Wardrobe Sessions with PrivateImage blob rendering).

issues: React warning: uncontrolled to controlled input transition (Name field initial value undefined). Minor, cosmetic — should initialize form state to empty strings.

action_items: Optional: Initialize signup form state to empty strings to eliminate uncontrolled→controlled React warning (SignupPage.jsx).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 947 lines — approaching threshold; consider splitting admin routes and try-on routes into separate routers for maintainability.
GET /api/files/{file_id} has redundant check (both branches on lines 549-554 handle admin case; the second `if` is unreachable). Harmless but dead code.

storage_client uses synchronous `requests`; called from async endpoints. It IS wrapped indirectly (uploads happen in the request thread and blocks the event loop briefly). For production, wrap put_object/get_object with `asyncio.to_thread`.

HFIDMVTONAdapter timeout is not enforced explicitly — relies on gradio_client defaults; a 90s+ queue could block the request thread. Consider adding a wall-clock timeout in server.py using asyncio.wait_for around asyncio.to_thread.
product_connectors._scrape_generic honestly reports failures — matches PDF 'No Fake AI' policy.
Anonymisation uses SHA256(user_id + JWT_SECRET) — deterministic and non-reversible for external parties. Good.
seed_data_creation: Registered ephemeral users (test_user_*, test_user2_*, uitest_*) and imported test products via /api/admin/import/json with source_id prefix TESTSKU / UITEST for identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features (object storage, HF adapter with mock fallback, product import JSON/URL with honest failure, anonymised export) verified end-to-end. HF adapter test currently exercised the fallback path (HF space was queued/asleep — expected). Skip repeat testing unless adapter code changes. Frontend blob-URL PrivateImage confirmed on both TryOn result and Wardrobe Try-On History tab.
